---
title: "PCA"
format: html
---

```{r}
options(bitmapType = "cairo")
dat_avg <- readRDS("../data/data_aug.rds")
```

## Make wide for PCA

```{r}
dat_avg_wide <- dat_avg |>   
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(title,geo_accession, mouse, timepoint, tissue),
              names_from  = ENTREZ_ID,
              values_from = expression
              )
```

## PCA for all organs

```{r}
expr_mat <- dat_avg_wide |>
  dplyr::select(-title, -geo_accession, -mouse, -timepoint, -tissue) |>
  as.matrix()

rownames(expr_mat) <- dat_avg_wide$title   # or geo_accession

pca <- prcomp(expr_mat, scale. = TRUE)

pca.var <- pca$sdev^2
pca.var.per <- round(pca.var/sum(pca.var)*100, 1)
barplot(pca.var.per, main="Scree Plot", xlab="Principal Component",
        ylab="Percent variation")


```

#### Make ggplot PCA 1 and 2

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
pca.data <- data.frame(Sample=rownames(pca$x),
                       X=pca$x[,1],
                       Y=pca$x[,2],
                       tissue = dat_avg_wide$tissue,
                       time = dat_avg_wide$timepoint)
ggplot(data=pca.data, aes(X, Y, label=Sample, color=tissue, shape=time)) +
  geom_point() +
  xlab(paste("PC1 - ", pca.var.per[1], "%", sep="")) + 
  ylab(paste("PC2 - ", pca.var.per[2], "%", sep="")) +
  theme_bw()+
  ggtitle("My PCA graph")
```

### Check loading scores for PC1of all organs

```{r}
loading_scores <- pca$rotation[,1]
gene_scores <- abs(loading_scores)
gene_scores_ranked <- sort(gene_scores, decreasing = TRUE)
top_10_genes <- names(gene_scores_ranked[1:10])
top_10_genes
pca$rotation[top_10_genes,1]
```
